_note: SIMULATED instruments for an educational prototype. None of these is a real security, an offer, or affiliated with any issuer named in its description. Every value marked as an assumption is a modelling choice, not observed data.

instruments.name: Sterling century bond (model)
instruments.description: A 100-year sterling corporate bond modelled on the kind of century tranche Alphabet issued in 2026. Educational model only: not an Alphabet security and not endorsed by Alphabet.
assumptions: Coupon 6.00% paid annually: assumed. The real tranche's coupon and payment frequency were not available in sources checked.
Issue date 30 Mar 2026: assumed from reporting dated 31 Mar 2026.
Credit spread 95 bp over gilts: assumed for a very highly rated issuer at a 100-year tenor. Not observed.
No gilt curve reaches 100 years, so rates beyond the curve's last point are held flat.

instruments.name: Three-year US dollar corporate bond (model)
instruments.description: A generic single-A rated, three-year US dollar corporate bond, included to contrast short duration with the century bond.
assumptions: Issuer, single-A rating and 4.50% semi-annual coupon: assumed.
Credit spread 110 bp over Treasuries: assumed for a single-A three-year bond. Not observed.
